QUOTE: when `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is not defined, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`... inside the library, the fields are ordinary struct members... Every library `.c`/`.h` that includes `common.h`... sees the real member names.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that code defining the opt-out sees real member names, while default consumers (e.g., ssl_context_info.c) see mangled `private_` names.
